dataset_split.evaluation_split: held-out test partition (18,000 images, balanced 50% real / 50% AI)

provenance.hardware_environment: Distributed Cloud GPU Supercluster (15x NVIDIA Tesla GPUs)

gap_ablation.resolution: The manuscript's ablation table represents the canonical 18,000-image re-run evaluated on 2026-09-29 on the frozen e8db master manifest.

mfft_large.description: High-capacity variant of the proposed architecture

ablation_band_4bands.description: Base backbone evaluated with 4-band frequency decomposition ablation

parameter_count_architecture_distinction.resolution: MFFT-Large (6.30M) and ablation_band_4bands (1.92M) are distinct architectures: Large uses a wider and deeper transformer backbone (embed_dim=768, layers=4), while ablation_band_4bands uses the Base backbone (embed_dim=384, layers=3).

master_manifest_sha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest computed directly from the exact raw file bytes of the master dataset manifest (manifest/split_manifest.json, 12,617,880 bytes) on Hugging Face (MohsinElis/mfft-master-manifest), representing the canonical frozen inventory of 120,000 images.

split_config_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash over deterministic JSON split configuration payload: {'seed': int, 'test': int, 'total': int, 'train': int, 'val': int} sorted by key. Identifies split hyperparameters, not partition membership.

split_manifest_sha256.description: Legacy compatibility anchor preserving the canonical seed-42 manifest split configuration hash ('e8db1a72...'). Historically cited in early pipeline logs and manuscript drafts before byte-level manifest file hashing was introduced. Retained for backward compatibility.

partition_membership_hashes.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digests over the canonical compact JSON-serialized integer index arrays pointing into the 120,000-sample master manifest: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(indices, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest().
